module_signature.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in while high
module_signature.name: load_en

module_signature.description: Serial data input, key MSB-first then plaintext MSB-first
module_signature.name: din

module_signature.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted
module_signature.name: shift_out_en

module_signature.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
module_signature.name: done

rationale_notes: plan: {"is_clocked": true, "key_state": ["fsm_state", "key_reg[79:0]", "state[63:0]", "load_bit_counter", "round_counter", "done"], "reset_summary": "While rst_n is low (asynchronous), done is immediately driven to 0, the FSM returns to IDLE state, load_bit_counter is cleared to 0, round_counter is cleared to 0, and unload_bit_counter is cleared to 0. The values of state[63:0] and key_reg[79:0] are undefined after reset. dout is driven to 0. All in-progress load, encrypt, or unload operations are abandoned immediately without waiting for a clock edge.", "step_summary": "Per cycle, the FSM advances through four phases. In IDLE/LOAD phase: if load_en is high, the 144-bit shift register {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]} shifts left by one bit and din is inserted at bit 0; the load_bit_counter increments by 1; when load_bit_counter reaches 144 on that same cycle, the FSM transitions to ENCRYPT and round_counter is set to 1. In ENCRYPT phase: each cycle executes one full PRESENT-80 round \u2014 state XORed with key_reg[79:16] (addRoundKey), then S-box applied to all 16 nibbles (sBoxLayer), then pLayer permutation applied (pLayer), then key schedule update (rotate key_reg left 61 bits, S-box top nibble, XOR round counter into bits [19:15]); round_counter increments; after 31 such rounds, on cycle 32 only addRoundKey is applied (no S-box/pLayer/key-schedule), done is set to 1, FSM moves to DONE. In DONE phase: if shift_out_en is high, dout outputs state[63] and state shifts left by one bit; if load_en is asserted, done clears and FSM returns to LOAD with load_bit_counter reset to 0. Async reset immediately clears done, FSM to IDLE, and all counters to 0.", "worked_example": [{"cycle_index": 0, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 0, "load_en": 0, "rst_n": 0, "shift_out_en": 0}}, {"cycle_index": 1, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 1, "load_en": 1, "rst_n": 1, "shift_out_en": 0}}, {"cycle_index": 2, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 0, "load_en": 1, "rst_n": 1, "shift_out_en": 0}}, {"cycle_index": 3, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 0, "load_en": 0, "rst_n": 1, "shift_out_en": 0}}, {"cycle_index": 4, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 0, "load_en": 0, "rst_n": 0, "shift_out_en": 0}}, {"cycle_index": 5, "expected_output": {"done": 0, "dout": 0}, "stim": {"din": 1, "load_en": 1, "rst_n": 1, "shift_out_en": 0}}]}
Implement PRESENT-80 block cipher reference model with serial load/unload, FSM control, and full round computation.
pLayer: bit i of input goes to position P(i)=(i*16)%63 for i=0..62, P(63)=63
Key schedule: rotate left 61 bits, S-box top nibble, XOR round counter into bits [19:15]
Load phase: 144 bits MSB-first into {key_reg[79:0], state[63:0]}, auto-start encrypt on 144th bit
Encrypt: 31 full rounds + 1 final addRoundKey = 32 cycles total
Done phase: shift out ciphertext MSB-first when shift_out_en high
